research_rationale: The original machine clause contains a header rather than the operative order. The corrected exact span captures the conditional private-facility VA contracting authority tied to DOD requests for active-duty members in Operation Desert Storm. The held EO:13350 context expressly revokes EO:12751 and section 10 makes that effective at 12:01 a.m. EDT July 30, 2004. Section 1 preserves matured rights and duties and prior actions. The original is flagged for official page verification, which is unavailable under this run scope. The conditional text also prevents treating formal revocation as a demonstrated earliest end without evidence on its operation.
